levels.coachText: New pack! Fill every empty cell.
New rule! Same colors can't touch edge to edge.
New rule! One piece doesn't belong. Leave it in the tray.
New rule! Some pieces are in the wrong place. Fix them.
New rule! Matching colors MUST touch.
New rule! A locked piece is already on the board.
New rule! You only get a few turns.
New rule! Place the biggest leftover piece first.
New rule! Every piece must touch the board edge.
New rule! Every piece must touch a black block.
New rule! Stay inside a room. Don't bridge the walls.
New rule! Two pieces don't belong. Leave both.
New rule! Undo is off. Think before you drop.
